consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance at the Marin County Veteran's Auditorium on March 31, 1984, was a standout for the year, showcasing a relaxed and innovative vibe. Despite some criticisms regarding sound quality and Jerry's vocals, many highlight the energy and creativity of the band, particularly during key songs.
